fields.label: Line 7. Credit carryover from prior year.
fields.pdfWidgetName: Line 7. Credit carryover from prior year

fields.pdfWidgetName: Line 8. Total available Disabled Access Credit. Add line 6 and line 7

fields.label: Line 9a. Credit claimed. Enter the amount of the credit claimed on the current year tax return. See instructions. (Do not include any assigned credit claimed on form FTB 3544, Part B).
fields.pdfWidgetName: Line 9a. Credit claimed. Enter the amount of the credit claimed on the current year tax return. See instructions. (Do not include any assigned credit claimed on form FTB 3544, Part B)

fields.pdfWidgetName: Line 9b. Total credit assigned. Enter the total amount from form FTB 3544, Part A, column (g). If you are not a corporation, enter 0. See instructions
